svg.aria-label: Level 02, CryoNet (2026): Real-time multiplayer relay service. Quest: Replace Photon Fusion without touching a single game RPC call. Build: Rooms, a lobby and an RPC relay, where every room change is an atomic Redis Lua script. Boss fight: Dropped connections: per-room sequence numbers replay every missed message on rejoin. Tech: TypeScript, Redis, Lua, Socket.IO, Unity SDK.
